text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This year's Ibis Summer Dash was buzzing with unprecedented excitement.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What is this? The racetrack is shaking.
It's completely different from last year.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Last year was pretty ordinary. Everyone was
just a little excited, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So this is the gap between me and Bakushin O...
My spirit's been crushed. Snapped clean in two, completely pulverized.
choice_data_list: To think that you're losing confidence...
For you to lose confidence like this...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even I can feel it.
This is what they call playing away from home, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is true that it all started with Sakura Bakushin O's
declaration of war. However, this thriving success
was not solely due to her efforts alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are just as many expectations for Calstone Light O.
There are people captivated by the romance of
pure, top-speed running.
choice_data_list: You'll understand once you're in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then I shall go check.
It is just about time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Believe-san.
You're here too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. But weren't you in an important period yourself?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I've finally returned to the front lines.
Now is the time to take on graded stakes races.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However... I felt that today's race, at least,
was something I had to see with my own eyes.
As a sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Same here.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ...A swell is beginning to form.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, the tide of history.
Ever since Bakushin O-chan declared her entry,
all sorts of changes have been brewing, haven't they?”

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Today, in this race.
That swell will surely reach its absolute peak.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Right O-o-oh! Break away from the pack today too!
Let us feel that thrill from last year's Ibis again!

text_block_list.name: Niigata Local Spectator
text_block_list.text:
The Niigata straight 1000m is Right O's home turf!
I won't even lose to Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna be the fastest Umamusume, right?
Show us the greatest speed in history!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
! Just as you said, Trainer...
I can hear it—their anticipation for top speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's even more intense than last year.
If I can run amidst this burning heat—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I have been eagerly awaiting this moment!
Right O-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let us compete to see who is the strongest and fastest!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will break my personal top speed record.
The course is a straight,
and I have a rival in Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Breaking my top speed is an inevitability.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However, the one who wins will be me! Because I am the strongest sprinter, Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest means—being the fastest
and never losing, that is what makes you the strongest!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Then take down that sign of yours.
Be content as just an ordinary Sakura Bakushin O!"
